column1:
Influence the electronics industry and our supply chain to improve human  
rights performance.
column2:
In 2014, we rolled out a number of new capacity-building programs for our 
suppliers that focus on human rights issues in the electronics supply chain. 
We also continue to work closely with the Electronics Industry Citizenship 
Coalition and other industry organizations to improve human rights performance 
throughout our industry.

column2:
We elected not to conduct this assessment in 2014, but will continue to regularly 
review our human rights policies and practices in this space.
